bathAction.title: Wash stomach
bathAction.tooltip: Wash the stomach and the small of the back.

description.text: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(wash)] [npc.her] stomach, following the curve of [npc.her] waist, then [npc.verb(reach)] around to the small of [npc.her] back and [npc.verb(rinse)] both. The water finds the crease above [npc.her] hips and takes the sweat with it. [npc.speech(Front, then the small of my back. I always miss that.)]

[npc.Name] [npc.verb(slide)] both palms over [npc.her] stomach and around [npc.her] waist, letting the hot water follow [npc.her] hands. [npc.She] [npc.verb(sigh)] and [npc.verb(lean)] into it, in no hurry to move lower yet. [npc.speech(Warm all the way down. I could stay on this bit.)]
[npc.Name] [npc.verb(scrub)] [npc.her] stomach and the small of [npc.her] back in a few impatient strokes, then [npc.verb(rinse)] and [npc.verb(move)] on. [npc.speech(It is clean. Stop stroking it.)]
